lines.text: nevermore.
I've wanted the world and lost my soul.
I want nothing more than to just be myself and nothing more
and be alright.
I do believe I'll be alright.
This reclaimed and dust settled heart rediscovered but dusted hands remind me
but say to me in this still muted tree in night garden
feels silence nevermore.
Now go.
